fusions.name: Arcane Grapnel
fusions.desc: Hurls a grapnel of raw arcana that deals 30 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts for 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Snatched Incantation
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 6 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 8 arcane damage, taking its next action away and knocking it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Reeled-In Ley
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Charge
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
